title: Celestial Harp Rain
description: A luminous white harp stands centrally, emitting colorful musical notes, lightning bolts, and rainbow teardrop shapes that cascade downward. In the background, a blurred audience of indistinct figures watches under bright beams of light from above, with colorful splashes and confetti scattered across the foreground floor.
prompt: impressionistic painting of a glowing white harp at the center of a stage, surrounded by falling colorful musical notes, rainbow droplets, and bright lightning bolts. Beams of heavenly light shine down from above onto a blurred audience of indistinct figures in the background. Colorful confetti and paint splashes cover the floor, soft pastel color palette with energetic joyful atmosphere, visible brushstrokes.
